summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Digital Currency X Technology Inc. reporting a private placement of $700 million units, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and three warrants at $2.11 per unit, with expected close in June 2026. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act; it does not trigger any special-situation category.
